its vertices on C1. Let altitudes AD, BE and CF intersect C1 again at points H, J and K 
respectively. If C2 is incircle of DEF and D  (8, 9), then which of the following is/are TRUE? 
(A) 
K1 is equal to 375 
(B) 
The distance of orthocentre of ABC from vertex C is equal to 5 2 units  
(C) 
AD is equal to 7 10 units 
(D) 
Area of hexagon AKBHCJA is equal to 1050 sq. units 
A, B, C, D

Equation of side BC is x + 3y – 35 = 0

….. (3)

A child moves one unit distance for each step he takes. He can move forward, backward, up or 
down either parallel to x-axis or y-axis. If he starts from (0, 0), then what is the probability that he 
is at (2, 2) at the end of 6 steps?
